name: Jean
notes: Both sources agree on 4pc Viridescent Venerer (Noblesse Oblige for an ATK buffer), ATK% or ER sands, Anemo DMG goblet, Burst first. Game8 splits three builds (sub-DPS: Gladiator's Finale or Viridescent with Primordial Jade Cutter; healer: Viridescent with Freedom-Sworn; ATK buffer: Noblesse with Primordial Jade Cutter), KQM two (support, and an EM 'Sunfire' build which is left out). The circlet is CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG with Healing Bonus as the healer option. ER 160 is the top of KQM's 'double Anemo or with Raiden' range (140-160) and the bottom of its solo Anemo range (160-200). Neither source gives ATK or CRIT goals, so only ER is set; the confidence is medium for that reason. Partners: any swirl-able element, so Pyro, Hydro, Electro and Cryo.
